title: Wikipedia sources
summary: Study lessons built on Wikipedia articles, kept for offline reading and checked again against their sources.
description: A lesson about a city, a custom or a piece of history should be right, and stay right as its source changes.

stories.as: a learner curious about a place or a custom
stories.want: lessons written from Wikipedia with the article kept alongside
stories.soThat: I can trust the facts and read more offline

requirements.text: The tutor can attach Wikipedia articles to a study lesson, new or existing, and remove them.
A lesson's page lists its sources; each opens in the app's reader from the stored copy, without the network.
The reader offers the Polish article when Polish Wikipedia has one.
The reader shows the credit the licence (CC BY-SA 4.0) asks for.
A lesson with sources is checked every `wiki.check-every`: each source's current revision is compared with the stored one.
An article that changed is fetched again and an AI corrects only what the lesson now gets wrong, noting what changed on the lesson's page.
The learner can run the check on demand from the lesson's page.

values.description: How often a lesson is checked against its sources.
